duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
duas.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت سُـبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْـتُ مِنَ الظّـالِميـن
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Al-Hakim declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/ 505. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/168.
benefits: Seeking refuge from distress and sorrow
duas.occasion: When in distress or difficult circumstances

context: This supplication is from the chapter dealing with supplications for those experiencing distress (al-kerb). It emphasizes the oneness of Allah and acknowledges one's fallibility, making it a powerful dua for overcoming hardship and seeking divine mercy.
